context.architecture: Replace the retained high-dimensional logistic model with a compact, illumination-robust handcrafted feature extractor and RBF SVM. Features combine normalized RGB/HSV spatial color statistics, gradient orientation histograms, edge density, and multi-scale pooled moments. Tune C and gamma on tune.csv using macro-F1, then refit the selected model on all fit.csv data. The artifact contains the fitted scaler, SVM, label mapping, preprocessing metadata, seed, and observed validation trajectory; prediction reloads identically in a fresh process.
